items.title: عالم الفيزياء كريستوفر ستابس ينضم إلى صندوق أنثروبيك طويل الأجل للمنافع
items.titleOriginal: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.summary: انضم الدكتور كريستوفر ستابس، عالم الفيزياء التجريبية وعميد العلوم السابق في جامعة هارفارد، إلى صندوق Anthropic's Long - Term Benefit Trust. إنه يحضر إلى الصندوق الاستئماني
items.summaryOriginal: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement. He has also advised the US government on national security and arms control. “I am honored to join Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust and to help the company deliver on its public benefit mission,” said Stubbs. “I use AI tools in my research every day and see what they make possible, and as an educator I have confronted some of the hard questions they raise. As a grandfather, I want to help ensure that AI is developed and deployed for the long-term benefit of humanity.” Stubbs is the Samuel C. Moncher Professor of Physics and of Astronomy at Harvard, where he served as Dean of Science from 2018 to 2024. In 1998, as a member of the High-Z Supernova Search Team, he helped discover the accelerating expansion of the universe, work that later earned the team the Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics. He was also the inaugural project scientist for what is now the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, which started a 10-year survey of the southern sky in June. One of its aims is to study the accelerating expansion he helped discover. More recently, he’s written about how to keep AI-assisted research reproducible when models can give different answers to the same question. He’s a member of JASON, an independent group of scientists who have advised the US government on defense and technology since 1960. "When Chris found evidence that the universe was expanding at a rate no one expected, he and his team followed the data even when it went against the prevailing wisdom of the field. As AI starts to transform how science itself is done, Chris’s intellectual honesty, rigor, and commitment to the truth are the values we want shaping the future of this technology, and I’m grateful he’s bringing his deep expertise to the Trust," said Daniela Amodei, Co-founder and President of Anthropic. Anthropic is a Public Benefit Corporation, which means we’re structured to balance commercial growth with our public benefit purpose. The Trust exists to help us hold that balance over the long term. It has the authority to appoint a majority of Anthropic’s board, and Trustees advise the board and our leadership on critical decisions, particularly those involving risks and societal impacts of AI. This week we published our first Public Benefit Report [link], a public account of how we’re working toward our mission and where we’re falling short. The Trustees helped define the five mission pillars it measures us against, and the report closes with their assessment of our progress to date. Subject to stockholder approval, we’ve also committed to setting aside a portion of Anthropic’s shares to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows. “Anthropic's Public Benefit Report sets out what we’re all working toward: helping the world build powerful AI safely, and making sure the technology drives advances that meaningfully improve people’s lives and society as a whole,” added Neil Buddy Shah, Chair of the Long-Term Benefit Trust. “Both goals depend on a deep understanding of frontier science and leading with integrity. Not only has Chris worked on some of the hardest problems in science, but he has consistently been a high-integrity leader of large, complex, collaborative scientific endeavors across academia, government, and the national laboratories. That will be of great value to the Trust as we support Anthropic in developing AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.” Stubbs, the Trust’s first physicist, joins Shah, national security expert Richard Fontaine, and former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke. Trustees are independent of the company’s management and investors.

items.title: ما وراء ذاكرة التخزين المؤقت لـ KV: تدريب وخدمة نموذج الاهتمام الخطي Laplace 3B من i14 على AWS Trainium2 مع PyTorch الأصلي
items.titleOriginal: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch
items.summary: تعرف على كيفية تدريب i14 وتقديم لابلاس 3B، نموذج الاهتمام الخطي، على AWS Trainium2 باستخدام PyTorch الأصلي. تظل حالته المتكررة ثابتة عند 29.5 ميجابايت لكل تسلسل ريجا
items.summaryOriginal: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable.

items.summary: يتيح خادم بروتوكول سياق نموذج الورقة الذكية (MCP) لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي قراءة بيانات إدارة العمل المباشرة وتحديثها والتصرف بناءً عليها. يوضح هذا المنشور طريقتين لربطه على AWS: Amazo
items.summaryOriginal: The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server lets AI agents read, update, and act on live work management data. This post shows two ways to connect it on AWS: Amazon Quick for business teams and Kiro for developers, so your agents can work with Smartsheet without switching tools.

items.titleOriginal: From data to decisions: Conversational supply chain intelligence with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: سلاسل التوريد الخاصة بالمؤسسات غنية بالبيانات ولكنها تفتقر إلى البصيرة، حيث تكون البيانات التي يتم تحديدها متناثرة عبر تخطيط موارد المؤسسات والمراقبة والمشتريات والبريد الإلكتروني. يوضح هذا المنشور كيف أن Amazon Bedr
items.summaryOriginal: Enterprise supply chains are data-rich but insight-poor, with the data to decide scattered across ERP, monitoring, procurement, and email. This post shows how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore exposes those systems as a governed tool layer, and how Amazon Quick turns them into one conversational experience for business users, with a deploy-it-yourself walkthrough.
